_meta.description: Versioned limitation and procedural deadline rules for Indian criminal law.
_meta.disclaimer: ILLUSTRATIVE — verify every rule against current statute text before professional use. All period values and event types are synthetic/demo defaults only.
primary_sources: Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (CrPC) — as in force
Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (BNSS) — Chapter VIII / XIV
Indian Evidence Act, 1872 / Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023

rules.name: Charge-sheet filing deadline (serious offences)
rules.name_hi: आरोप-पत्र दाखिल करने की समय-सीमा (गंभीर अपराध)
rules.applies_to: Offences punishable with death, life imprisonment or imprisonment ≥ 10 years
rules.extension_rule: Default bail accrues automatically if charge-sheet not filed within period
rules.consequence: Accused entitled to default bail under §167(2) proviso
rules.consequence_hi: §167(2) के अनुसार आरोपी को डिफ़ॉल्ट जमानत का अधिकार
rules.source_note: ILLUSTRATIVE. Verify §167(2) CrPC / §187(2) BNSS text. Period may differ based on charge and court order.

rules.name: Charge-sheet filing deadline (other offences)
rules.name_hi: आरोप-पत्र दाखिल करने की समय-सीमा (अन्य अपराध)
rules.applies_to: All other cognisable offences not covered by CRPC-167-90D
rules.extension_rule: Court may extend on application; default bail accrues if no extension granted
rules.consequence: Accused entitled to default bail on expiry if charge-sheet absent
rules.consequence_hi: अवधि समाप्त होने पर डिफ़ॉल्ट जमानत का अधिकार
rules.source_note: ILLUSTRATIVE. Confirm applicable tier (90D vs 60D) against specific charge before use.

rules.name: Police report / final report submission
rules.name_hi: पुलिस रिपोर्ट / अंतिम रिपोर्ट दाखिल करने की अवधि
rules.applies_to: Completion of investigation and filing of charge-sheet from FIR date
rules.extension_rule: Magistrate may extend on application stating reasons
rules.consequence: Delay attracts judicial scrutiny; accused may seek bail on unexplained delay
rules.consequence_hi: विलंब पर न्यायिक समीक्षा; जमानत याचिका का आधार बन सकता है
rules.source_note: ILLUSTRATIVE. §173 CrPC does not prescribe a fixed number of days; 90-day figure is derived from §167(2) read with §173. Verify with current case law.

rules.name: Next hearing date — statutory maximum adjournment
rules.name_hi: अगली सुनवाई तिथि — अधिकतम स्थगन अवधि
rules.applies_to: Adjournment during trial — next date ordinarily within 30 days
rules.extension_rule: Special reasons required for adjournment beyond 30 days
rules.consequence: Prolonged adjournments without reasons are assailable in revision
rules.consequence_hi: 30 दिन से अधिक स्थगन बिना कारण के पुनरीक्षण में चुनौती योग्य
rules.source_note: ILLUSTRATIVE. §309 direction is aspirational; actual practice varies. Verify with current HC circular.

rules.name: Limitation for taking cognisance (3 years)
rules.applies_to: Offences punishable with imprisonment > 1 year but ≤ 3 years
rules.extension_rule: §473 CrPC: court may condone delay on sufficient cause shown
rules.consequence: Cognisance beyond limitation is assailable as barred; defence may seek discharge
rules.consequence_hi: परिसीमा के बाद संज्ञान आक्षेपणीय; निर्मुक्ति याचिका का आधार
rules.source_note: ILLUSTRATIVE. §468(2)(c) CrPC / corresponding BNSS provision. Verify quantum of sentence for specific charge.

rules.name: Limitation for taking cognisance (1 year)
rules.applies_to: Offences punishable with imprisonment > 6 months but ≤ 1 year
rules.extension_rule: §473 CrPC: court may condone delay on sufficient cause
rules.consequence: Cognisance barred after 1 year from incident unless condonation granted
rules.consequence_hi: 1 वर्ष बाद संज्ञान वर्जित जब तक क्षमा स्वीकार न हो
rules.source_note: ILLUSTRATIVE. Verify sentence quantum for specific charge under current code.

rules.name: Sessions Court bail application — next date
rules.name_hi: सत्र न्यायालय जमानत आवेदन — अगली तिथि
rules.applies_to: Regular bail application pending before Sessions Court
rules.extension_rule: No statutory deadline; 7 working days is standard HC direction
rules.consequence: Delayed hearing may found a writ petition before HC
rules.consequence_hi: विलंब पर उच्च न्यायालय में रिट याचिका का आधार
rules.source_note: ILLUSTRATIVE. 7-working-day period is based on common HC practice directions, not a statutory provision. Verify HC rules.

rules.name: Discharge application hearing — first date
rules.applies_to: Discharge application under §227 CrPC after charge-sheet filed
rules.extension_rule: No statutory deadline; 30 calendar days is a pragmatic reference point
rules.consequence: Prolonged non-listing is assailable in revision or supervisory jurisdiction
rules.consequence_hi: लंबित सूचीबद्धता उच्च न्यायालय की पर्यवेक्षी अधिकारिता में चुनौती योग्य
rules.source_note: ILLUSTRATIVE. No statute prescribes this period. Verify current court calendar and HC administrative circulars.

rules.name: FSL report receipt — expected turnaround
rules.applies_to: Forensic analysis report (chemical / structural) from accredited lab
rules.extension_rule: Complex analyses (mortar strength, chemical composition) may take up to 90 days
rules.consequence: Delay in FSL report affects charge-sheet filing timeline under §173 CrPC
rules.consequence_hi: एफएसएल विलंब §173 के तहत आरोप-पत्र दाखिल करने की अवधि को प्रभावित करता है
rules.source_note: ILLUSTRATIVE. No statute prescribes FSL turnaround. 60-day figure is a typical NABL-lab reference. Verify with actual lab SLA.

rules.name: SLP filing deadline from HC order
rules.name_hi: एचसी आदेश से एसएलपी दाखिल करने की समय-सीमा
rules.applies_to: Special Leave Petition to Supreme Court from High Court judgment/order
rules.extension_rule: Delay may be condoned by Supreme Court on application under Art. 136
rules.consequence: SLP filed after 90 days requires separate delay-condonation application
rules.consequence_hi: 90 दिन के बाद एसएलपी में विलंब माफी का अलग आवेदन आवश्यक
rules.source_note: ILLUSTRATIVE. Verify current SC Rules and practice directions. Limitation period may differ for criminal appeals.
